description: Layered search across the conversation and knowledge corpora. Returns handles + snippets only — call memory_get with chosen handles for full text. `layers` narrows by layer (turn_summary, episode, knowledge); empty = all. Documents are NOT searched here — use document_search. `kinds` narrows knowledge hits (decision, insight, note). Legacy layer names 'decision'/'insight' are accepted and mean knowledge restricted to that kind. status: 'active' (default) hides superseded/retired knowledge, 'any' includes them. since/until: 'YYYY-MM-DD', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS', or relative ('30d', '12h'). For conversation history use memory_get(session=..., after_turn=...).

exclude_session.description: Drop results from this session GUID.

layers.description: Restrict to these layers (turn_summary, episode, knowledge). 'turn' is raw exchange text, searched only when named explicitly; prefer the summaries. 'session' matches session titles (lexical only, opt-in). Documents use document_search.

mode.description: hybrid (default) | semantic (vector only; needs an embedder) | keyword (text index only).

session.description: Only results from this session GUID.

status.description: Decisions only: active (default) | any | one exact status.

tags.description: Knowledge rows must carry ALL listed tags (AND rule; trimmed, case-insensitive; `project:<name>` is just a tag). A comma string is accepted. Layers without tags are excluded.

name: memory_search
